prompt: A photorealistic wide frame of a small, hard-surfaced coroner's examination room, taken from a lens on a wall bracket above the door and looking down across the room. A stainless steel table stands in the centre of the frame with a body under a white sheet, and a pair of white trainers hangs out of the end of the sheet, their toes and laces soaked dark red with blood, a smear of the same red on the steel beneath them. Giles stands beside the table on the right of the frame, his head slightly lowered and his brows drawn together, one finger pressed to his ear and his lips moving as though speaking quietly into the air, his eyes aimed at the floor. Pale tiled walls, a steel sink, a wall clock with blank hands and a trolley of covered trays recede behind him. The light is hard fluorescent strip light with cold green-white reflections on the steel, producing a washed-out picture with compression blocks, grain and slightly blown highlights on the table. No readable writing or numbers anywhere in frame. Thanks.
